question: In January 2022, who was sworn in as the first woman president of Honduras?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Xiomara Castro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Honduras, **Xiomara Castro** has been sworn in as** the first female President of the country.**
 
• She is a member of the **Freedom and Refoundation Party (Libre).**
